briefs.headline: Bitcoin ~$78,871: still a two-way stall on the 90-day tape
briefs.lede: 90-day change about +18.8%. Issue 14’s working map remains the $77–80k observation box until a Daily close decides.
briefs.bodyHtml:
Fact (CoinGecko). Last ~$78,871. Ninety-day path +18.8% from the start of this window. Bars below are day-over-day changes in reported spot volume (USD), overlaid with price — a Glassnode-style dual panel, not an ETF creation print.

Analysis. Volume spikes that do not reclaim the failed high zone are still digestion inside the stall. Quiet green bars under $80k are not confirmation of a floor.

Scenarios. A — Daily acceptance back above $80k toward $81–81.5k. B — Daily acceptance below $77k opens the deeper process map (75.6k / 71.7–72.3k). Invalidation is the Daily close, not an intraday wick.

Educational scenario research. Not advice. No leverage.
